title: Electron
description: Adds block crusher be able to break and process blocks as resource, and others
body:
This mod adds crusher, redstone machine that be able to crush and process a front block.
And some new features will be added.

*This mod have been experimental.

# Features:
- Crusher
- Builder
- Silver ore and tools (immune to undead)

# Planned Features:
- Electrum ingredient and tools
- Electron (new tool)
- Copper duct
- and others!
